{{Infobox map |name=Schobble |year=2024 |image=schobble_01.jpg |creator=[[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[quaker]] |gametype=12on12 |size=Large |download=https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/details/629/schobble/ }} Schobble (schobble_beta.bsp) is a large Team Deathmatch map created in 2024 by [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[quaker]] and [[Image:flag_no.gif]] [[Link]] .
Schobble = [[Schloss]] + [[Qobblestone]], 2 maps put together for 1 larger map, like for example [[death32c]] and [[superdm32]]. The intention is to play 12 vs 12 and FFA. [[Image:flag_ca.gif]] [[infiniti]] was the rocketscientist who came up with the name. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=2 |ring=1 |pent=1 |hp100=4 |ra=2 |ya=2 |ga=4 |lg=1 |rl=4 |gl=2 |sng=2 |ng= |ssg=4 }} ==Gallery== schobble_01.jpg schobble_02.jpg schobble_03.jpg schobble_04.jpg schobble_05.jpg schobble_06.jpg schobble_07.jpg schobble_08.jpg schobble_09.jpg ==Layout== Schloss and Qobblestone are connected with one big crossing that got 2 entrances to each map. There is also a 2-way teleporter that connect the maps. Other than that the maps play the same with the same layout and items. 1 spawn has been added to the large crossing and a large cell box has been added to schloss side (rl-cathedral).

==Strategy & Tactics== As the maps play the same as the original ones, with some difference in connectivity, the main difference is that you now got 2 quads and you get a LG to schloss side and have pent at qobblestone side. ===Download=== You can download the map [https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/details/629/schobble/ HERE]
